name: Select default port 1958 if not specified

transactions.reply:
20 text/gemini
Client connected to server on default port 1958

stdout: Client connected to server on default port 1958
justification: Project manual directly say that protocol uses port 1958 'We run the protocol over TCP port 1958, instead of Gemini’s port 1965'. If client do not specify the port then the default port 1958 should be used

name: Get file with many lines

transactions.reply:
20 text/plain
-Hello world 
 -Hello human 
 -This was just a test 
 -ok bye

stdout:
-Hello world 
 -Hello human 
 -This was just a test 
 -ok bye
justification:
The requirement 2 in the project manual states that you need to 'dump the raw bytes'. So you need to make sure that text do not stop reading the file when 
 is introduced and read the whole file.

name: The servers permanent issue
justification: The requirement 2 says to treat all errors that starts with 5 as permanent errors and report to System.err.

name: Server suddenly disconnect
justification: Project manual in the requirement 2 was described that if the local error occurs then System.err should be printed. The causes for this can be connectivity issues like server suddenly disconnecting.

name: Understand MIME types
justification: In project manual requirement 3 it says to use text/gemini for the .gmi files. The server should correctly identify MIME type for files

name: Leave the root directory
justification: It is prohibited to go outside of root directory for safety reasons. The project manual requirement 3 says that client cannot go outside of root directory

name: No file found
justification: This is exception during request processing when file is not found. According to project manual requirement 3 the error code should start with 5

name: Handle MIME type for unknown file formats
justification: The projet manual requirement 3 asks to use (but does not mandate) application/octet-stream for unknown file formats

name: Proxy handle successful request
justification: Proxy should transfer the request to server and then provide the client with the response. In the project manual requirement 4 it is written that proxy should act as a client and then send reply to the original client

name: The missing server
justification: The project manual requirment 4 directly states that if the proxy cannot connect to server, it should return error 43
